header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Anil Kumar advocate for the petitioner.
body: 2-4. Through the instant petition, the petitioner prays that direction be issued to respondent No.4 Mukhtiarkar, Taluka Kot Ghulam Muhammad District Mirpurkhas to consider the request of the petitioner in respect of fotikhatabadal. Learned A.A.G appearing in other cases waives notice and submits that it is the duty of respondent No.4 to entertain application of the petitioner and decide it in accordance with the law.

In view of the above, the instant petition stands disposed of alongwith listed applications with directions to respondent No.4 to redress the grievance of the petitioner within thirty (30) days in accordance with law and submit compliance report through Additional Registrar of this Court. A copy of this order be communicated to the Deputy Commissioner, Mirpurkhas for information and compliance.
